description: Gate A golden of the M0 test room: the scene camera's view, the last frame of a 30-frame run. The style 26.2 checklist for it is in docs/testing/gate-a.md.

image.format: PNG, 8-bit RGB, sRGB-encoded as the window shows it

scene.camera: scene camera: eye (-0.6, 1.65, 0.9) m, yaw 9 deg, pitch -7 deg, horizontal FOV 75 deg

comparison: The same build, driver and scene give the same bytes (two runs, before and after the commit, matched). Another driver or GPU can move pixels by an 8-bit step or two (dither, texture filtering, FXAA): compare with a tolerance.
